items.title: Firms 'holding back' on new jobs ahead of Budget
items.summary: According to BBC reporting, businesses in Devon are calling for reduced employment costs ahead of the upcoming Budget.

items.title: Four revenue options examined by BBC Verify ahead of the Budget
items.summary: According to BBC Verify reporting, the Chancellor faces pressure to restore the government fiscal buffer and fund spending while adhering to manifesto pledges not to raise income tax, VAT or National Insurance rates.

items.title: City economists doubt Bank of England will push interest rates to 4.75%
items.summary: Experts consulted by The Guardian say financial markets are wrong to predict a full percentage point rise by next summer, citing limited spillover from energy costs.

items.title: Nationwide cuts 275 jobs in latest round following Virgin Money takeover
items.summary: According to reporting by The Guardian, Nationwide Building Society is cutting 275 roles as part of efforts to simplify operations and remove duplication following its £2.9bn acquisition of Virgin Money.

items.title: Chancellor unveils major funding package for UK artificial intelligence and security
items.summary: The Treasury has announced a comprehensive multi-million-pound investment package aimed at scaling up domestic artificial intelligence firms, bolstering national cyber defences, and protecting against emerging biological threats.

items.title: FCA Publishes First-Half 2025 Data on UK Cash Access Coverage
items.summary: The financial regulator has released its geographical monitoring report detailing consumer proximity to cash access points across the UK for the first half of 2025.
